messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] HIGH p99 latency on /v1/chat/completions (us-west) — p99=1.4s, baseline 600ms. triggered 8m ago
jamie: taking it, oncall here. which models/routes affected?
sara: quick glance — traffic spike concentrated on route=/v1/chat/completions model=mistral-xl and model=mistral-8k. p95 mildly up, p99 spiking.
mike: yep — looks correlated with a customer batch test hitting long contexts. see grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc/chat-p99?orgId=1
jamie: okay. immediate mitigation options: 1) temporary alert threshold bump (reduce noise) 2) add short-term per-model threshold 3) add short debounce/hysteresis so transient spikes don't page. prefer (2)+(3).
sara: agree. suggest: set p99 threshold for model=mistral-xl on /v1/chat/completions to 1.2s (was 600ms) and for mistral-8k to 1.0s, plus 5m evaluation window. then we can instrument a dynamic hysteresis: only fire if >threshold for 3/5 windows.
mike: if we change thresholds we should record customer impact first. any customers reporting errors? support queue quiet so far. no 5xxs, just latency.
jamie: noted. no active P1 customer reports. tagging @support to confirm.
elaine: support: two customers on dedicated capacity reported slow responses but nothing blocking. ops asked for mitigation.
jamie: ok proceeding with safe threshold bump and hysteresis; will also add a temporary alert mute for repeated pages (30m).
jamie: applying change now — updating alert rule in datadog:
```
# datadog monitor snippet
avg(last_5m):max:service.chat.p99{env:prod,route:/v1/chat/completions,model:mistral-xl} > 1.2
notify_no_data: false
evaluation_delay: 60
```
jamie: also adding condition: fire only if exceeded in 3 out of last 5 checks (Datadog "recovery window").
sara: add tagged note in alert definition: "temp threshold for ongoing spike; revert after 2h and postmortem"
mike: creating a per-route dashboard panel and a short runbook entry for oncall — will push to "eng-sre/alerts" dashboard.
jamie: rolling change deployed. monitoring for 10m.
incident-bot: [INFO] monitor update applied by jamie at 2026-03-17T12:15:03Z
mike: quick look — p99 for mistral-xl dropped from 1.4s to ~840ms in last 5m since routing changes/batching kicked in.
jamie: nice. still watching. can we add a permanent per-model threshold ticket? current alerts are too coarse.
sara: filing ticket: https://tickets/redwood/INC-4521 — propose per-model/per-route p95/p99 baselines and sigma-based hysteresis.
elaine: handoff in 30m to night oncall. jamie — please prepare a short handoff note: what changed, why, and revert plan.
jamie: handoff note: "Raised p99 thresholds for mistral-xl->1.2s, mistral-8k->1.0s; added 3/5 window hysteresis; temporary 30m squelch on repeat pages; monitor for 2h then revert if stable. No active customer outages; two customers reported slow responses but not blocking."
sara: also add dashboards: per-model p95/p99, per-route error counts, prefix KV cache hit rate.
mike: will attach dashboard links to ticket.
jamie: handing off to night oncall @elaine in 25m. @incident-bot logging this thread as incident draft.
incident-bot: [LOG] incident draft created (id=INC-4521-draft).
elaine: received, thanks. I'll watch for regressions and will escalate if p99 goes above 1.5s or if customers raise P1.
jamie: thanks team — postmortem to follow if we see >30% sustained p99 regression after revert. otherwise just update alert rules permanently based on ENG-1234 recommendations. :thumbsup:
